question: In which Indian state are the cities of Quepem and Curchorem located?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Goa.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The cities of Quepem and Curchorem located in **Goa**.
 
• **Curchorem **(Kudchade) is a town and municipal council in the South Goa district of Goa, India.
 
• **Quepem **is a town with a municipal council in South Goa district in the Indian state of Goa.
 
 
• The town is the administrative headquarters of the Quepem taluka.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Goa is a state in western India with coastlines stretching along the Arabian Sea.

 
 
• It is India's smallest state (1,429 square miles).
 
 
 
• 30, May 1987 is the Goa formation day.
 
• Some facts about Goa:
 
 
• Capital: Panaji
 
• Governor: Shri P.S. Sreedharan Pillai
 
• CM: Pramod Pandurang Sawant
 
• Official language: Konkani
 
• Largest city: Vasco da Gama
 
• Number of districts: 2 (North Goa and South Goa)
